title: JetBlue Airways: Phase 56I First-Pass Decision
summary: DOT's May 2026 operating-carrier table records JetBlue Airways on-time arrivals at 81.0 percent across 64 reported airports. Phase 56I decision: The first pass preserves a compatible monthly operating-carrier observation but remains Partially Closed because the 2026 full-year denominator, cause controls, complaints, accessibility, and verified remedy delivery are incomplete.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Later full-year cancellation and schedule denominator.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen after BTS publishes December 2026 data and DOT issues the full-year 2026 reporting tables.
why_it_matters: The first-pass decision records whether a named official rail supplies the required denominator without converting adjacent or partial evidence into false closure.
ftfn_relevance: Completes the Phase 56I first-pass queue under a dated source check.
Keeps evidence state separate from performance, safety, quality, readiness, and value.
evidence_limits: One monthly on-time percentage cannot be combined with cancellations, complaints, baggage, accessibility, network, weather, schedule, cause, or remedy measures and does not authorize a cross-carrier ranking.
Full-year cancellations and schedule, route and airport mix, weather, maintenance, crew controls, complaints, and verified remedies.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
